title: Deep-Cleaning Allowance on the Listing Cleaning Fee — HostCover Claim Schedule (Listings)
content:
# Deep-Cleaning Allowance

*Allowance schedule for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims.*

## Rule

On top of the standard cleaning-fee ceiling, a listing may carry a deep-cleaning allowance, worked out on the day of the cleaning-fee reset. The allowance rests on the Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims in the deep cleaning category that the claims team approved and that were filed on the listing within the deep-cleaning look-back. Those claims are counted and their verified losses added up:

- when **two or more** such claims were filed, **or** their verified losses add up to **$1000.00 or more**, the deep-cleaning allowance is **$60.00**;
- when **exactly one** such claim was filed **and** its verified loss is below $1000.00, it is **$30.00**;
- when **none** was, there is no deep-cleaning allowance.

The allowance is added to the listing's cleaning-fee ceiling.

## Combinations

| Approved deep-cleaning claims in the look-back | Their verified losses together | Deep-cleaning allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | any amount | $60.00 |
| exactly 1 | $1000.00 or more | $60.00 |
| exactly 1 | below $1000.00 | $30.00 |
| none | — | none |

## Cases (hypothetical claims)

- One approved deep-cleaning claim with a verified loss of $1000.00: the losses reach $1000.00, so the allowance is $60.00.
- One approved deep-cleaning claim with a verified loss of $999.99: exactly one claim and below $1000.00, so the allowance is $30.00.
- Two approved deep-cleaning claims with verified losses of $120.00 and $180.00: two claims, so the allowance is $60.00 although the losses come to $300.00.
- One approved property-damage claim and one denied deep-cleaning claim: no approved deep-cleaning claim, so there is no deep-cleaning allowance.
